verses.gurmukhi: ਗੰਨਾ ਕੋਲੂ ਪੀੜੀਐ ਰਸੁ ਦੇ ਦਰਹਾਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: ga(n)naa koloo peeReeaai ras dhe dharahaalaa|

en.bdb: Crushed by the crushing machine sugarcane gives juice instantly.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਕਰੇ ਗੁੜੁ ਭੇਲੀਆਂ ਕੋ ਸਕਰ ਵਾਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: koiee kare guR bheleeaa(n) ko sakar vaalaa|

en.bdb: Some prepare lumps of jaggery and brown sugar out of it.
Some prepare refined sugar and some adding in it sweet drops make special jaggery.
It is moulded into lump sugar and variegated sweets.

verses.gurmukhi: ਖਾਵੈ ਰਾਜਾ ਰੰਕੁ ਕਰਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਸੁਖਾਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: khaavai raajaa ra(n)k kar ras bhog sukhaalaa|

en.bdb: The poor and the wealthy both eat it with pleasure.
God (similar to sugarcane juice) permeates through all; for gurmukhs He is the essence of all the pleasures.
